## Design System

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Tool | shadcn (already initialized — `components.json`) |
| Preset | `k7Tmw2Qe9x` — **locked**; style `base-linden`, base color `stone`, theme `green`. Nothing is re-initialized. |
| Component library | **base-ui** (`@base-ui/react`). The phase 2 contract called this Radix by mistake; this row corrects it. |

**Already installed (phase 2):** `Card`, `Badge`, `Progress`, `Alert`, `Skeleton`, `Button`.

**New primitives this phase needs:**

| Component | Used for |
|-----------|----------|

## Spacing Scale

| Token | Value | Usage |
|-------|-------|-------|
| xs | 4px | Icon gaps |
| sm | 8px | Gap between the switcher and the trail |
| md | 16px | Table cell padding |
| lg | 24px | Page padding |
| xl | 32px | Gap between the toolbar and the table |
| 2xl | 48px | Not used this phase |

**Exceptions:** each table row is 44px tall, which is both the touch target and the virtualizer's fixed row size.

## Copywriting Contract

| Element | Copy |
|---------|------|
| Empty shelf heading | **"This shelf is empty"** |
| Empty shelf body | **"Tools you add will show up here."** |
| Listing failed | **"Could not load this shelf. Try again."** |
| Shed silent | **"{Shed} has not reported lately. Try again."** |

## UI Considerations

> Populated by the ui-phase UI-consideration probe (Step 9.5) and lifted by plan-phase's
> `## UI Considerations` lift rule via the identical rule as SPEC `## Edge Coverage`. Shape-rooted UI *state*
> coverage (empty / loading / error / populated / partial / overflow / zero-one-many / long-text).
> Empty-state and error-state COPY live in `## Copywriting Contract` above.

Probe (Step 9.5) classified 7 surfaces → 44 applicable state-category candidates. Resolved: **11 covered, 1 backstop, 0 unresolved**; the rest are dismissed as non-applicable (single controls and fixed sets — see the note below).

| Category | Element(s) | Status | Resolution / Reason |
|----------|------------|--------|---------------------|
| empty | catalogue list (E1) | ✅ covered | An empty shelf shows the heading and body from the Copywriting Contract, with no illustration. |
| loading | catalogue list (E1) | ✅ covered | Skeleton rows render while the fetch runs; the trail and switcher stay usable. |
| loading | shed switcher (E2) | ✅ covered | The tabs stay interactive while the list loads; only the pane below shows a skeleton. |
| error | catalogue list — not found (E1) | ✅ covered | The generic "Could not load this shelf" copy. |
| error | shed silent in-pane (E1/E2) | ✅ covered | The in-pane state is the source of truth; the switcher dot is only a hint. |
| populated | catalogue list (E1, shelves and tools) | ✅ covered | Shelves first, then tools in natural A–Z; columns are name, count, shelf and condition. |
| populated | shed switcher (E2, status dots) | ✅ covered | Healthy is the accent dot, low is destructive, silent is muted. |
| overflow | name column — long names (E1) | ✅ covered | The column truncates with an ellipsis and carries a native `title`. |
| overflow / long-text | shelf trail — deep path, narrow screen (E3) | ✅ covered | The trail row scrolls sideways on its own. |
| zero-one-many | catalogue list — 0 / 1 / 4,000 rows (E1) | ✅ covered | One renderer handles every count through the virtualizer. |
| overflow / long-text | repair note text (E4) | ✅ covered | The note wraps and can be selected; it is never cut. |
| partial | mixed per-tool data — a tool with no last-seen date (E1) | 🧪 backstop | It was not decided whether any shed omits a column's source. Show `—` in that cell rather than dropping the column. |

**Dismissed as non-applicable (reasoned, not dropped):** the probe over-generated data-state categories for the single controls E4 Repair button, E5 Refresh button and the Switch, because each is atomic and has no data shape of its own.
